# 🪟 Windows Systems & PowerShell Automation Track

Welcome to the **Windows Systems & PowerShell Automation Track** materialized by **Trak**.

This workspace is an in-depth curriculum covering Windows NT kernel architecture, PowerShell object-oriented pipelines, NTFS reparse points, Registry hives, WMI/CIM management, Windows Services, and production automation.

## 📚 Syllabus & Module Map

| Module | Title | Key Topics & Internals |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `00-setup-powershell7-and-winget` | PowerShell 7 & Winget | PowerShell Core (`$PSVersionTable`), `winget` package manager, Windows Terminal |
| `01-windows-architecture-nt-kernel` | NT Kernel & Subsystems | Windows NT Executive, HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer), User vs Kernel mode |
| `02-powershell-cmdlets-and-object-pipeline` | Object-Oriented Pipelines | Objects vs text streams, `Get-Member` (`gm`), pipeline parameter binding, `Select-Object` |
| `03-filesystem-ntfs-and-reparse-points` | NTFS & Reparse Points | Junctions, Symbolic Links, Alternate Data Streams (`Get-Item -Stream`), ACLs |
| `04-registry-internals-and-hives` | Windows Registry Architecture | HKLM, HKCU, `Get-ItemProperty`, Registry providers, transactional registry |
| `05-process-management-and-services` | Processes & Services | `Get-Process`, `Get-Service`, `sc.exe`, service startup types, handles & threads |
| `06-wmi-and-cim-infrastructure` | WMI & CIM Infrastructure | `Get-CimInstance`, `Win32_OperatingSystem`, `Win32_LogicalDisk`, WQL queries |
| `07-active-directory-and-security` | Security & Identifiers | Security Identifiers (SIDs), DACLs, SACLs, Kerberos & NTLM authentication |
| `08-windows-networking-and-dns` | Networking & WinRM | `Get-NetIPAddress`, `Test-NetConnection`, DNS cache, PowerShell Remoting (`Enter-PSSession`) |
| `09-scheduled-tasks-and-job-scheduling` | Task Scheduler | `Get-ScheduledTask`, `Register-ScheduledTask`, Task Triggers, Task Actions |
| `10-windows-event-logs-and-wevtutil` | Event Logs & Diagnostics | `Get-WinEvent` with XPath filters, Application/System/Security channels, `wevtutil` |
| `11-user-account-control-and-privileges` | UAC & Elevation Tokens | Token filtering, UAC prompt levels, administrator elevation, privileges (SeDebugPrivilege) |
| `12-windows-subsystem-for-linux-wsl2` | WSL2 & Virtualization | Hyper-V architecture, `wsl.exe`, `/mnt/c/` filesystem interop, `.wslconfig` |
| `13-windows-memory-and-performance` | Memory & Performance Counters | Virtual memory paging (`pagefile.sys`), Commit Charge, `Get-Counter`, PerfMon |
| `14-batch-and-cmd-interoperability` | CMD & Batch Compatibility | Batch scripting (`.cmd`), environment variables (`%PATH%`), PowerShell interop |
| `15-powershell-scripting-and-modules` | Advanced Scripts & Modules | `[CmdletBinding()]`, `param()` validation, `$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'`, `.psm1` |
| `16-windows-installer-msi-and-sysprep` | MSI & DISM Image Servicing | `msiexec.exe /qn`, DISM image cleanup, Windows Setup customization |
| `17-testing-with-pester` | Testing with Pester | BDD testing framework (`Describe`, `Context`, `It`, `Should -Be`), mock cmdlets |
| `18-interview-questions-and-drills` | Interview Mastery Drills | Top 10 Windows SysAdmin & SRE gotchas + Production Health Diagnostics Drill |

---

## 🛠️ How to Practice
Each module contains:
- `README.md` — Deep theoretical explanation and architecture notes.
- `example.ps1` — Fully runnable concept demonstration.
- `exercise/starter.ps1` — Hands-on problem with `TODO` markers.
- `exercise/solution.ps1` — Complete reference solution.

# 01 — Windows NT Architecture & HAL

## 🎯 Architecture Layers
- **HAL (Hardware Abstraction Layer)**: Hides CPU differences from the OS kernel.
- **Executive**: Memory Manager, Process/Thread Manager, Security Reference Monitor (SRM), I/O Manager.
- **User Mode**: Win32 Subsystem, Windows Services, Application processes.

children.name: example.ps1
children.content:
Write-Host "=== 01: Windows System Architecture ==="
$os = Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem
Write-Host "Operating System: $($os.Caption)"
Write-Host "Build Number:     $($os.BuildNumber)"
Write-Host "Architecture:     $($os.OSArchitecture)"

children.name: starter.ps1
children.content:

children.name: solution.ps1

$uptime = (Get-Date) - $os.LastBootUpTime
Write-Host "System Uptime: $($uptime.Days) days, $($uptime.Hours) hours, $($uptime.Minutes) minutes"

# 02 — PowerShell Object Pipelines vs Text Streams

## 🎯 The Object Pipeline
Unlike Unix shells that pass unstructured byte streams, PowerShell passes rich .NET objects across the pipeline `|`.
Use `Get-Member` (`gm`) to inspect methods and properties of any pipeline object.

# 04 — Windows Registry Architecture

## 🎯 Key Hives
- `HKLM` (`HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE`): Machine-wide settings (Software, System hardware).
- `HKCU` (`HKEY_CURRENT_USER`): Current logged-in user profile settings.

Write-Host "Product Name: $($product.ProductName)"
Write-Host "Display Version: $($product.DisplayVersion)"

# 06 — Modern CIM & WMI Infrastructure

## 🎯 Why CIM over WMI?
- `Get-CimInstance` uses open WS-Man standards (ports 5985/5986) rather than legacy DCOM/RPC.

Write-Host "Processor: $($cpu.Name)"
Write-Host "Cores:     $($cpu.NumberOfCores)"
Write-Host "Threads:   $($cpu.NumberOfLogicalProcessors)"

# 18 — High-Yield Windows SysAdmin & PowerShell Interview Drills

## 🧠 Top 10 Gotchas
1. **Execution Policy**: `Set-ExecutionPolicy` is a safety net against accidental execution, not a security boundary.
2. **Objects vs Text**: Piping output passes structured .NET objects with typed properties.
3. **`$null` on Left Side**: Always write `$null -eq $variable` to avoid array filtering bugs.
4. **WinRM TrustedHosts**: Cross-domain remoting requires `Set-Item WSMan:\localhost\Client\TrustedHosts`.
5. **64-bit vs 32-bit Registry**: 32-bit processes are redirected to `SysWOW64` and `Wow6432Node`.
6. **UAC Token Filtering**: Scheduled tasks run without elevation unless configured with `RunLevel Highest`.
7. **Alternate Data Streams (ADS)**: Zone.Identifier stream marks files downloaded from internet.
8. **PowerShell Scopes**: `Global`, `Script`, `Local`, `Private` scope inheritance.
9. **WMI vs CIM**: CIM uses modern WS-Man over firewall-friendly HTTP/HTTPS.
10. **`try/catch` Requirement**: Only catches terminating errors (`$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'`).
